profile.visual_desc: Bulky robotic humanoid in blue and grey plating. Features large rounded pauldrons, back-mounted exhaust tubes, and a green waist cloth.
profile.face_cutin_desc: Stoic metallic grey faceplate with a single, horizontal blue glowing visor slit and blue trim.
profile.weapon_desc: Dual silver retractable forearm blades mounted to each wrist.
profile.step1_ready: Standing front-facing with arms crossed over the chest in a disciplined idle pose.
profile.step2_windup: Unfolds arms and deploys wrist blades outward, preparing to lunge forward.
profile.step3_impact: Lunges toward the bottom-right, unleashing a massive, wide yellow energy beam from the swinging forearm blade.
profile.step4_finish: Holds a deep lunging stance as the large energy trail flickers and dissipates into small orange sparks.
profile.kp7_slash_vfx_rule: The wide yellow energy beam in Frame 4 correctly follows the horizontal-diagonal trajectory of the right wrist blade's swing.

evaluation.diagnosis: The animation sequence shows moderate alignment with the DOS windup and VFX phases. Pose consistency and perspective remain stable across the frames.
